verdict.rationale: Gitea's first-party site says users can "extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks" to build custom workflows. It also advertises syncing with Slack, Discord, MS Teams and Lark, which implies outbound event notifications. The evidence is a thin marketing mention rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: documentation of supported event types and payloads, per-repo/org/system subscription scopes, delivery and security details (secrets, signatures, retries), and independent or hands-on confirmation.
